parent: C04 incentive mechanism proof, C03 Kloc leaderboard offer RCT

drift.reason: Same PFL forecasting domain, expands estimand from activity to scoring accuracy, error covariance and public-recognition welfare; different causal treatments, target and evidence requirements.

A.question: Can assignment to public relative rank, holding social forecast information separately randomized, raise opportunity-normalized participation while degrading population forecast quality, causing correlated forecast errors, or reducing welfare? Which combinations (not single aggregate KPI) Pareto-dominate?
A.unit: preassigned fictional participant × preannounced, unresolved factual question, clustered by leaderboard room
A.population: only future consenting eligible participants in an expressly authorized pilot, NOT public politicians nor people in historical source files
treatments: R: private rank vs public rank recognition
S: social forecast information withheld vs displayed, within ethical constraints
A.comparator: competent two-factor 2×2 cluster randomized control with shared identical question calendar, incentives, UI time and feedback frequency
A.primary: assigned roster normalized first forecast uptake; policy forecast Brier improvement vs frozen ex ante independent baseline for all eligible question opportunities, no forecast leaves baseline in place
A.harm: private welfare/opt-out decisions, exposure-triggered discomfort and forecast-error covariance as separate guardrails; absence of response is not an imputed personal prediction

B.H_R: Public recognition may raise uptake but lower willingness to be ranked and increase churn among low rank; rival Zou & Gao 2023 suggests performance gain with welfare loss.
B.H_S: Seeing others' forecasts may improve mean forecast accuracy but correlate errors, potentially increasing tail risk, as Adjodah et al. 2021 studied.
B.H_interaction: Joint public rank and social-belief access may change strategic extremization; rival Witkowski et al. 2023 shows winner-take-all proper score is not sufficient truthfulness.
B.H0: No identifiable interaction or joint trade-off after strong controls; all apparent effects explained by post-treatment exposure selection, room mix or timing.
strong_existing_rivals: Kloc, Belo, Li 2024 real offer/no board
Lovász et al. 2023 leaderboard × subjective feedback 2×4
Zou & Gao 2023 private/partial/full public recognition with WTP
Atanasov et al. 2016/17 randomized geopolitical prediction market vs prediction polls
Adjodah et al. 2021 social information and crowd accuracy-risk
Witkowski et al. 2023 proper prize ranking mechanism
Chen et al. 2023 randomized contest social versus competitive information

C.preregister_future_population_and_exposu: complete random assignment list including 0 responders; question release/close, signup, actual independent pre-answer impressions, rank visibility, missed display logs UNKNOWN, not known zero
C.assignment: predefine clusters at room level and possible cross-room interaction; if unbounded spillovers, redesign units or interference mapping rather than call individual SUTVA
C.causal_estimands: ITT for assignment Z_R/Z_S and their interaction on all-eligible uptake and policy forecast score; conditional exposed analysis only secondary under additional identification assumptions
C.policy_scoring: Freeze independent baseline p0_q for each question before treatment. For a consenting nonrespondent leave policy forecast p0_q unchanged; any first user response is policy update p_iq. Score outcomes only when objectively resolved, compared to predeclared baseline. This estimates policy utility not latent forecasting skill or true belief.
C.risk: cross-participant correlated signed errors and worst-quantile aggregate loss on held-out questions, NOT only mean individual Brier
C.welfare: ethics-cleared optional opt-out and at most minimal privacy intrusions; voluntary WTP elicitation only if specifically reviewed
falsifiers: No increase in assignment-based coverage despite apparent respondent-only activity rise
Mean Brier improves but worst-quantile social forecasts deteriorate (risk hidden by mean)
Reported desire for private scoring even if public display improves activity
No benefit survives prior-art competent comparator, heterogeneity and interference-aware inference
C.holdout: prospective distinct future questions and newly enrolled authorized participants; no reuse of earlier outcome-conditioned records
C.multiplicity: co-primary families and harm guardrails must be frozen before access; no informal threshold choice from observed data
C.power: not specified without feasible user recruitment/ethics/pilot budget; NOT a preregistered executable study

D.sources_status: Only publicly available paper/abstract texts and citations inspected; no original participant rows
D.source_rights_gate: Before running require documented origin, permitted data processing, participant privacy/consent and source reuse for this specific analysis

E.reason: No consent/ethics clearance, randomized exposure instrumentation, eligible complete roster, holdout, legal access or powered sample available.

adversarial: Brier incentive not equivalent to truthful competitive report; winner-take-all can distort forecasts
Public rank not same as social forecast access or rank position
Never condition ITT on recipients who stayed active 3 days
Question-level missingness and opt-out cannot be swept under carpet
Avoid inventing interventions (real politician ranking, money prize) not confirmed within PFL scope
Multiple possible mediators and transport across financial/educational vs political forecasting

G.independent_evidence: Strong existing randomized/field/lab studies oppose novelty; no joint external replication on this PFL policy estimand verified

H.priors: Cumulative PF-BR33+; separate engagement, predictive calibration, social-information risk, welfare, strategy-proofness
H.CT2_status: Hold 20/100 ordinal absent new empirical outcome or clearer novelty test

I.source_reliability: Multiple independent publications, but transfer to intended product not established

J.trigger_to_reopen: Legally and ethically permitted full assignment data with controlled independent exposures and novel precommitted interaction/harm outcome, or authorized prospective human pilot with rights and validity cleared
J.alternative: If no access, do not consume slot or run synthetic seed variants
